subject.title: fix(agents): agent-created files get lowercased names on Windows

question: Does the current sandbox-path contract permit replacing comparison-key lowercasing with case-preserving normalization for the relative path returned to Windows agent file-writing callers?
rationale: The intended outcome is sound and the PR supplies focused tests, but this code sits on the path traversal boundary and mirrors behavior owned by `@openclaw/fs-safe`; maintainer confirmation is needed before changing that canonicalization contract.

options.title: Confirm contract and merge
options.body: Confirm that current fs-safe normalization requires only prefix/separator handling for this returned path, then merge after a final focused Windows boundary refresh.

options.title: Move the helper into fs-safe
options.body: If this normalization is a shared filesystem contract, expose a case-preserving variant from the dependency and update this PR to consume it rather than duplicating its behavior.

options.title: Keep comparison normalization
options.body: Retain the existing behavior only if maintainers determine that lowercasing is required for a containment invariant not captured by the new tests.

recommendation.title: Confirm contract and merge
recommendation.body: Confirm that current fs-safe normalization requires only prefix/separator handling for this returned path, then merge after a final focused Windows boundary refresh.
